title: Eduverse — Technical RFCs
summary: Nine technical architecture decision records (RFC-001 through RFC-009) locking critical platform decisions: dual-format rich content, transactional purchase pipeline, protected e-book encryption, hybrid lecture progress, dual-storage RBAC, recurring scheduler, course-level content migration, hybrid RTDB presence, and push notification delivery.
notes: Strong ADR signals with explicit Problem, Decision, Rationale, and File bindings across 9 locked architectural decisions.
